description: P3.4 (EVAL-04): the quality bounds TestRetrieval asserts, derived from the five development runs of this corpus (outputs/rag-eval reports tm7rks, tmllmn, tmlxok, tmme75 (a 15-case subset, excluded from the derivation), tmmje5: recall@5 0.818, nDCG@5 0.848, no-answer 15/15, false no-answer 9/66, no disclosure, no invalid citation, identical across runs). They are regression bounds of this DEVELOPMENT_ONLY corpus only: the business-labeled corpus and its thresholds are an ENV-05 input, and a different corpus digest refuses these bounds.
